title: Module 3: The Evaluation Phase
description: Use formative and summative evidence to judge whether instruction is working, and interpret Kirkpatrick's model as a layered evaluation framework.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish between Formative and Summative evaluation
Apply Kirkpatrick's four levels of evaluation
Design evidence-collection plans that align evaluation questions with instructional goals

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
